biggest_gap.title: The full verify fails: the G1 HTTP isolation gate times out, and the likely cause is round 3's repeat check, which runs about 24 database queries per branch on every tax-sequence PUT
biggest_gap.detail: Both of my full verifies failed G1HttpIsolationTests.Tenant_A_cannot_reach_tenant_B_through_any_endpoint, after 1 h 23 m and 1 h 40 m. One attack request ran past the HttpClient's 100 s timeout ('TaskCanceledException ... The client aborted the request'), so the gate never finished, and the round has no passing verify. The likely cause is new in this round, though not proven. SequenceEndpoints.RepeatedNumberAsync (owner rule 5) runs on every PUT to a tax sequence (sales.invoice, sales.creditNote) that changes prefix, suffix, padding, reset or perBranch. It loops over every period: one per branch when per-branch counting is on, plus each existing counter. For each period it loops over every date (12 per year for yearly, 12 per year with issued numbers for never) and every branch code, and sends one db.Issued query each time: about 24 queries per branch for a yearly per-branch pattern. Measured on the demo with an idle machine: the same PUT (prefix X-{BRANCH}-{YYYY}-, perBranch true) takes 0.04 s with 3 branches, 2.96 s with 403 and 16.98 s with 2,403. The same PUT on a non-tax sequence (purchase order) takes 0.01 to 0.03 s. G1 sends tenant B's values into A's own tax sequences, many requests in parallel, after its own branch-creating attacks, so the check can pass 100 s. Supporting this, not proof: the p00 r16 critic's run at 5e80b6c3 (before this merge) passed the same G1 test in 1 h 29 m, while the p07 r2 and p12 r3 critics' runs on later commits that contain this merge failed it the same way. Fix it without loosening the gate or raising any timeout: one set-based query per change (for example, read the issued numbers of this company and type once and match them in memory, or match on the period columns), with a cost that does not grow with the branch count, and a test that times the PUT with thousands of branches. Owner rule 5 must stay enforced, including the back-dated case in other_findings.
biggest_gap.evidence: verify-run1-kept/dotnet-suite.log:1042 and verify-run2-kept/dotnet-suite.log:1041 (error and stack: G1HttpIsolationTests.cs:1681 RawAsync <- :1558 ParameterAttackAsync <- :582 Parallel.ForEachAsync). Cost: probe-repeat-check-cost.txt and probe-repeat-check-cost.py (add branches with POST /api/tenancy/branches, then time PUT /api/numbering/sequences/{id} on ALN-DXB's sales.invoice and purchasing.order). Code: src/Modules/Numbering/Erp.Modules.Numbering/Sequences/SequenceEndpoints.cs, RepeatedNumberAsync (the nested foreach over periods, dates and codes, each awaiting db.Issued...ToListAsync), called from Update when tax is set and the pattern changed. Processor time: run 1 dotnet 7,136 s, web 2,192 s, e2e 599 s, peak load 75.5. Run 2 dotnet 9,877 s, web 2,066 s, e2e 529 s, peak load 70.8, mean 16.6. Another verify ran beside each.

other_findings: Owner rule 5 hole (docs/compliance/vat-tax-document-numbering.md, 'a change that could give a number already given is refused'). RepeatedNumberAsync checks only today's period and periods that already have a counter in the new reset's shape, so a reset change is accepted even though it can give a number already given for an earlier period. After that, every back-dated document in that period is refused with numbering.numberTaken. No duplicate is ever written; the unique index holds. (a) probe-backdated-month.log: the tax credit note CN-{YYYY}-{MM}- runs yearly and gives CN-2026-10-00001..3 dated October. Switching it to monthly is accepted (200). A credit note dated October is then refused (numberTaken), while one dated today gets CN-2026-11-00004. (b) probe-backdated-switch.log: the tax invoice INV-{YYYY}- with reset never gives INV-2025-00001..3 dated 2025-12-20. Switching to yearly is accepted. Every invoice dated 2025 is then refused (numberTaken). Both are reachable from the screen: 'never' with {YYYY} is allowed, and so is a yearly reset with {MM}. Probe code: probe-tests.diff.

[route: p01-odoo-rig] Comparison-harness self-tests failed under load in the web stage while another verify ran beside it. Run 1 (peak load 75): before-clock.test.mjs:322 'saved state: the honest path of a task that saves what the person enters verifies' and guard.test.mjs:819 'control (round 4): text copied inside the measured part may be pasted'. Run 2 (load 50 to 67 at the time): 'control (round 12): the honest approval click ... verify'. Each says 'invalid ... the page changed what it shows without a counted step causing it (StyleRecalcInvalidationTracking ...)'. These are the same class as gate backlog row 8 (controls that pass alone). A different test failed in each run. I had no quiet window to re-run them alone. Not skipped or loosened.

Rule 2 ('a number once given is never ... changed or deleted') rests only on there being no endpoint for it. The application role erp_app holds UPDATE and DELETE on numbering.issued_numbers (information_schema.role_table_grants), and no trigger refuses them. Revoking those grants, or adding a refusing trigger, would make the rule hold at the database too.

Scope present and working: tax invoice and tax credit note sequences are flagged tax and gapless always (the checkbox is checked and disabled). PUT with gapless false is refused (numberingTaxGapless), and so is PUT without gapless. Once a period's first number is given, the next number is fixed: forward moves get numberingGaplessNextNumberFixed, backward moves numberingNextNumberBelowIssued, and the field is disabled with a hint. A yearly reset without a year token is refused. A forward digits change saved by keyboard moves the preview from INV-2026-01203 to INV-2026-001203. The tax note and messages read the same in English and Arabic (tax-rules-api.txt, walk-notes.txt, 02/04/06/08 screenshots). Arabic is dir=rtl lang=ar, G then N reaches the screen, opening a row focuses the prefix, and the console shows no errors.

The r1 gap is fixed: the G1 false positive from the random control matching A's two-letter prefixes did not recur (G1 failed only on the timeout). The r1 'yearly to never and back' stuck counter is fixed for the same-year case (decision round 2; SequenceApiTests has a test for it).

Cosmetic: in the preview the date line wraps inside a document number ('INV-2027-' then '00001' on the next line), in English and Arabic (02-en-tax-invoice.jpg, 06-ar-tax-invoice.jpg). The number could be kept on one line, for example with nowrap or a no-break span.

Planted policy leak L1: the structural check caught it, but the behavioural check G1DatabaseIsolationTests.Application_role_sees_and_changes_only_its_own_tenant_in_every_tenant_table passed with the leak in place. Its seed probably has no tenant-B sales.invoice issued numbers for a type-keyed policy to expose. Not a gap, since the gate as a whole caught the plant; noted for p00's awareness.
The comparison task configure-sequence still measures only prefix and digits; the piece spec says 'with a yearly reset and preview the next number' (carried from r1, p01 frozen).
